One top-up of the Solana rent pool (planRentDeposit): lamports to deposit, whether the pool is still below the working set, whether it backs no slot and the wallet can't fund one, and what the next useful deposit needs. lamports is the pool account's balance, its own rent included; spendable is the payer's above its reserve. Quantities are decimal strings.
